ruins.name: Egg on Face
ruins.clue: He said don't give the egg to HIM. It's an ostrich egg. You do the maths.

ruins.name: Referee Sent Off
ruins.clue: Once you hold the whistle, you're the referee. Referees carry cards. There's a red one on the bench.

ruins.name: Windmill Wrecker
ruins.clue: Straight at the hole bounces off the windmill. Keep doing it. Windmills are not as strong as they look.

ruins.name: Board Flipper
ruins.clue: Nine queens against one pawn? There's a button for people who've had enough of chess.

ruins.name: Hurdle Dodger
ruins.clue: The rule card says what gets you disqualified. Do that. You still get through.
